objectives: This course provides an advanced study of atmospheric chemistry topics coerving from stratospheric and tropospheric chemsutry to aqueous and aerosol chemistry. Discussions on experimental setup and analytical methods are also given.
content:
1. Stratospheric Chemistry - Ozone chemistry
2. Tropospheric Chemistry – Air pollution chemistry
3. Aqueous Chemistry
4. Aerosol Chemistry
5. Measurements and Analytical Methods
